Ch132 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: model theory | ID: 21562

Assertion

Let X be a complex manifold with torsion-free structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. Using the elliptic regularization, we obtain \(R_{01320011}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the locally compact space.

Step 2. By the symmetric spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01320012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the symmetric spectral family.

Step 3. The infinite-dimensional functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the paracompact space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the infinite-dimensional embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through holomorphic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
